data.title: Building enquiry for garden house rejected
data.summary: The City of Beispielheim building authority (Baurechtsamt) rejected your preliminary building enquiry of 12 January 2026 for a garden house in the outlying area. The letter is dated 2 March 2026 and offers an objection (Widerspruch) within one month of notification.
data.explanation: The city has refused your request to build a 42 m³ garden house because it is not permitted in the outlying area (Außenbereich) and harms public interests. You may file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or record it at the city office; the app shows the deadline. It can also reach the responsible objection authority before the deadline. Decide whether to object, and consider professional advice. A separate fee notice (Gebührenbescheid) will follow, so watch your post.

items.title: File objection against rejection

date.text: Frist: ein Monat ab Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids.

items.quote: Rechtsbehelf: Widerspruch. Frist: ein Monat ab Bekanntgabe dieses Bescheids.
items.action: If you disagree, file an objection (Widerspruch) in writing or record it at the City of Beispielheim.
items.consequence: After the deadline the rejection becomes final and can no longer be challenged.

key_facts.quote: Für diese Entscheidung wird eine Gebühr festgesetzt; hierzu erhalten Sie einen gesonderten Gebührenbescheid.
